question: Kailangan ba na accredited brand ng BFP ang bibilhing fire extinguisher, at pwede bang magbenta ang inspector ng bombero?
answer:
Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungkol sa kailangan ba na accredited brand ng BFP ang bibilhing fire extinguisher, at pwede bang magbenta ang inspector ng bombero.

However, according to BFP Memorandum Circular No. 2016-016 [S2], there is a prohibition of BFP personnel from recommending any brand, store, or distributor of fire extinguisher and fire fighting equipment. This suggests that there is no requirement for the fire extinguisher to be accredited by the BFP. As for selling fire extinguishers, the document does not specify if inspectors are allowed to do so.

ground_truth: Under BFP Memorandum Circular No. 2016-016 and public anti-corruption warnings, the Bureau of Fire Protection does not accredit, endorse, or recommend any specific brand, store, or distributor of fire extinguishers or fire fighting equipment. BFP personnel are strictly prohibited from selling or recommending fire extinguishers. Portable fire extinguishers are regulated by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) through the Bureau of Product Standards (BPS), and establishments may purchase any brand that complies with Philippine National Standards (PNS).
